name: security-audit-skill
description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
one_liner: Turns an AI coding assistant into a methodical security inspector that hunts for vulnerabilities in your codebase, double-checks its own findings, and writes a real report — the same approach Cloudflare uses internally.
buyer: A freelance penetration tester or small security consultancy who wants to audit more client codebases per week without lowering quality, by having AI do the first-pass hunting that a human then verifies.
business_use_cases: A boutique security firm uses it to triage a new client's codebase overnight, then has a human analyst focus only on the confirmed findings the next morning.
A startup runs it before every major release as a pre-launch security gate, catching issues before a real pentest firm would charge thousands to find them.
A bug bounty hunter runs it across many open-source targets to surface candidate vulnerabilities faster than manual review, then submits verified ones.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'AI-assisted security audit' packages to startups that can't afford a full manual pentest, priced well below traditional audit firms.
Run it as a subscription CI check that re-audits a client's repo on every release and emails a findings report.

steal_this: Package this skill into a 'security audit in a weekend' service for indie SaaS founders: run it, have a human verify the top findings, deliver a clean PDF report for a flat fee.
